tasks.answer: Use ConfirmationDialog (re-exported by the dialog barrel). Required: triggerButton and confirmButton (React elements) plus title; body, cancelButtonText, icon and isDone are optional. The discussions feature wraps it in DeleteDiscussion, which takes only id and is admin-gated.

The login form uses Input from the form barrel. It binds react-hook-form by spreading registration={register('email')} / register('password') onto the native input (registration is required, typed Partial<UseFormRegisterReturn>); label and error are optional FieldWrapper pass-throughs.

DiscussionsList passes a pagination object to Table, which renders TablePagination. TablePagination requires totalPages, currentPage and rootUrl and builds links as `${rootUrl}?page=N`; it is not re-exported from the table barrel (index only exports ./table), so import it from table/pagination.
MDPreview takes the Markdown source in value, parses it with marked and sanitizes the HTML with DOMPurify before dangerouslySetInnerHTML (discussion-view passes discussion.body).

CreateDiscussion is a no-prop admin-only FormDrawer: it is wrapped in <Authorization allowedRoles={[ROLES.ADMIN]}>, so only ADMIN users see the trigger and can create a discussion (title + Markdown body).

notes: Shell invocations (8): ls repo/apps; find src dirs; find relevant feature/ui files; wc -c batches for sizes; sed field-wrapper; wc form.tsx + ls discussions components + sed authorization; wc/sed rest of authorization. Search strategy: located barrels and consumers first, then read only react-vite files; ignored nextjs-app/pages duplicates. Filtered out the forbidden catalog CLI and catalog JSON/config entirely. Uncertainty: Input label is optional in the type though always supplied in usage; TablePagination is not re-exported by the '@/components/ui/table' barrel (only Table is), so its direct import path is table/pagination, while normal use goes through Table's pagination prop.
